title: helictotrichon pratense f. alpinum
intro: Helictotrichon pratense f. alpinum, commonly known as Mountain Millet Grass or Alpine Silvergrass, is a type of ornamental grass native to mountainous regions of Europe. It is valued for its silvery-green foliage, delicate white flowers, and potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving sleep quality, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Helictotrichon pratense f. alpinum are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, which may help alleviate anxiety, stress, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
